onerilen.title: Rework
onerilen.author: Jason Fried
onerilen.description: Rework shows you a better, faster, easier way to succeed in business. Read it and you'll know why plans are actually harmful.

onerilen.title: Zero to One
onerilen.author: Peter Thiel
onerilen.description: The next Bill Gates will not build an operating system. The next Larry Page or Sergey Brin won't make a search engine.

onerilen.title: Clean Code
onerilen.author: Robert C. Martin
onerilen.description: Even bad code can function. But if code isn't clean, it can bring a development organization to its knees.

onerilen.author: Andrew Hunt
onerilen.description: One of the most significant books in practical software development, helping generations of programmers examine the very essence of their craft.

onerilen.title: Refactoring

onerilen.description: Any fool can write code that a computer can understand. Good programmers write code that humans can understand.

onerilen.title: Design Patterns

onerilen.description: Captures the engineering wisdom and blueprints of object-oriented software design from the world's master creators.

onerilen.description: The definitive comprehensive guide to standard computing and mathematical sorting, matching, and architecture algorithms.

onerilen.description: No matter how much experience you have with JavaScript, odds are you don't fully understand everything about the language.

onerilen.title: Head First Design Patterns

onerilen.description: A visually rich, brain-friendly guide to structural design, architecture, and behavioral patterns in development engineering.

onerilen.title: Soft Skills
onerilen.author: John Sonmez
onerilen.description: The software developer's life manual. Covers career management, marketing yourself, fitness, finance, and productivity engineering.

onerilen.title: The Clean Coder
onerilen.author: Robert C. Martin
onerilen.description: A guide to professional conduct, disciplines, engineering practices, and standard rules of pride for software developers.

onerilen.title: Cracking the Coding Interview
onerilen.author: Gayle Laakmann McDowell
onerilen.description: 189 programming questions and solutions, from binary trees to system engineering problems to help you pass backend developer exams.

onerilen.title: Continuous Delivery
onerilen.author: Jez Humble
onerilen.description: Reliable software releases through build, test, pipeline, and deployment automation systems for development operations.

onerilen.title: Domain-Driven Design
onerilen.author: Eric Evans
onerilen.description: Filling the gap between complex business processes and clean technical architecture in corporate software development.

onerilen.title: Working Effectively with Legacy Code
onerilen.author: Michael Feathers
onerilen.description: Get crucial strategies for modifying, testing, maintaining, and protecting vast systems that lack proper documentation.

onerilen.title: Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture
onerilen.author: Martin Fowler
onerilen.description: Deep enterprise-level blueprints for building solid layers, database mapping, data concurrency, and system sessions.

onerilen.title: The Mythical Man-Month
onerilen.author: Frederick P. Brooks Jr.
onerilen.description: Few books on project management have been as influential or timeless. Explains why adding manpower to a late software project makes it later.

onerilen.title: Peopleware
onerilen.author: Tom DeMarco
onerilen.description: The major problems of our work are not technological, they are sociological in nature. A masterpiece on engineering management.

onerilen.title: The Phoenix Project
onerilen.author: Gene Kim
onerilen.description: A novel about IT, DevOps, security engineering, and helping your business win through agile process transformations.

onerilen.title: The Goal
onerilen.author: Eliyahu M. Goldratt
onerilen.description: A business graphic-style novel focusing on the Theory of Constraints, continuous improvement, pipeline bottlenecks, and manufacturing efficiency.

onerilen.title: Drive
onerilen.author: Daniel H. Pink
onerilen.description: The surprising truth about what motivates us. Explores autonomy, mastery, and purpose versus standard reward systems.

onerilen.title: Hooked
onerilen.author: Nir Eyal
onerilen.description: How to build habit-forming products. Explores the structural UI hook cycle that keeps users coming back naturally.

onerilen.title: The Design of Everyday Things
onerilen.author: Don Norman
onerilen.description: Even the smartest among us can feel stupid trying to use a simple door or light switch. The ultimate Bible for UI/UX designers.

onerilen.title: Don't Make Me Think
onerilen.author: Steve Krug
onerilen.description: A common-sense guide to web and mobile usability, interface layouts, engineering simple pathways, and clean interface designs.

onerilen.title: Sprint

onerilen.description: How to solve big problems and test new ideas in just five days, directly from the Google Ventures startup framework.

onerilen.title: Badass: Making Users Awesome
onerilen.author: Kathy Sierra
onerilen.description: If you want your product to succeed, stop focusing on making a great product—focus on making your users successful.

onerilen.title: The Innovator's Dilemma
onerilen.author: Clayton M. Christensen
onerilen.description: When new technologies cause great firms to fail. Explores disruptive innovation, market transformation, and engineering pivots.

onerilen.title: Crossing the Chasm
onerilen.author: Geoffrey A. Moore
onerilen.description: Marketing and selling high-tech products to mainstream customers, navigating the gap between early adopters and pragmatists.

onerilen.title: High Output Management
onerilen.author: Andrew S. Grove
onerilen.description: The essential handbook for tech managers, directors, and startup founders from the former legendary CEO of Intel Corporation.

onerilen.title: Measure What Matters
onerilen.author: John Doerr
onerilen.description: How Google, Bono, and the Gates Foundation rock the world with OKRs (Objectives and Key Results) frameworks.

onerilen.title: The Hard Thing About Hard Things
onerilen.author: Ben Horowitz
onerilen.description: Building a business when there are no easy answers. Brutally honest corporate lessons on management, execution, and crises.

onerilen.title: Creativity, Inc.
onerilen.author: Ed Catmull
onerilen.description: Overcoming the unseen forces that stand in the way of true inspiration, written by the legendary co-founder of Pixar Animation.

onerilen.title: Principles: Life and Work
onerilen.author: Ray Dalio
onerilen.description: Dalio shares the unconventional business principles he developed to build Bridgewater Associates into an empire.

onerilen.title: Steve Jobs
onerilen.author: Walter Isaacson
onerilen.description: The exclusive, bestselling biography of Apple's iconic, creative, driven, and disruptive tech trailblazer.

onerilen.title: Elon Musk
onerilen.author: Ashlee Vance
onerilen.description: Tesla, SpaceX, and the quest for a fantastic future. A deep dive into the engineering mindset behind multi-planetary goals.

onerilen.title: Man's Search for Meaning
onerilen.author: Viktor E. Frankl
onerilen.description: A psychiatrist's memoir of surviving Nazi concentration camps, exploring the vital human psychological need for a dedicated purpose.

onerilen.title: The Daily Stoic
onerilen.author: Ryan Holiday
onerilen.description: 366 days of Stoic wisdom, meditation, resilience engineering, and focus on control, directly translating to chaotic workspaces.

onerilen.title: Ego Is the Enemy
onerilen.author: Ryan Holiday
onerilen.description: Many of us think the main obstacle to a successful life is the outside world. In fact, the enemy is usually found within.

onerilen.title: Obstacle Is the Way
onerilen.author: Ryan Holiday
onerilen.description: The timeless art of turning trials into triumphs, heavily based on standard Roman Stoicism and military problem-solving.

onerilen.title: Mindset: The New Psychology of Success
onerilen.author: Carol S. Dweck
onerilen.description: Explores the power of a growth mindset versus a fixed mindset, transforming how we view intelligence, engineering skill, and talent.

onerilen.title: Influence: Science and Practice
onerilen.author: Robert B. Cialdini
onerilen.description: The classic book on corporate persuasion, explaining the psychological triggers that make people say yes in negotiations.

onerilen.title: Never Split the Difference
onerilen.author: Chris Voss
onerilen.description: Negotiating as if your life depended on it. A former FBI hostage negotiator shares powerful psychological strategies for tech contracts.

onerilen.title: Crucial Conversations
onerilen.author: Kerry Patterson
onerilen.description: Tools for talking when stakes are high, opinions vary, and emotions run strong. Perfect for team sprints and launch days.

onerilen.title: Radical Candor
onerilen.author: Kim Scott
onerilen.description: How to be a kickass boss without losing your humanity. Teaches you how to challenge directly while caring personally about developers.

onerilen.title: Dare to Lead
onerilen.author: Brené Brown
onerilen.description: Brave work. Tough conversations. Whole hearts. Explores empathy, corporate structural trust, and operational leadership rules.

onerilen.title: Extreme Ownership
onerilen.author: Jocko Willink
onerilen.description: How U.S. Navy SEALs lead and win. Explains how engineering teams must take absolute accountability for pipeline deployment failures.

onerilen.title: The War of Art
onerilen.author: Steven Pressfield
onerilen.description: Break through the creative blocks and win your inner battles against procrastination, doubt, and mental project resistance.

onerilen.title: Steal Like an Artist
onerilen.author: Austin Kleon
onerilen.description: 10 things nobody told you about being creative. Explores pattern reuse, code inspirations, and standard UI components layouts.

onerilen.title: Show Your Work!
onerilen.author: Austin Kleon
onerilen.description: 10 ways to share your creativity and get discovered. An essential short manual for open-source developers and software designers.
